fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a roll that deals 22 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds, and tears out every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Thrashing Backlash
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long that deals 13 damage and leaves each enemy [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Whirlpool Drag
fusions.desc: Opens a whirlpool along a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait Repaid
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
